_comment: ALLINONE-AGENT Office Bridge auth (EXAMPLE). The REAL file (config/secrets/office-bridge-auth.json) is a mandatory publication exclusion per PUBLICATION-EXCLUSIONS.md and was never opened to build this template — this schema is derived only from the public architecture description in docs/legacy-platform-docs/OFFICE-BRIDGE.md (NTFS-ACL-protected token file, constant-time comparison, Origin/CSRF allowlist, owner RBAC, rate limiting). TODO: schema not yet confirmed field-for-field against the real file's structure — verify key names against a real running instance before relying on this template being complete.
_access_token_note: Generate with setup.ps1 (same mechanism as the owner Studio Access Token) — never hand-type a weak value here. Compared using constant-time equality, not ==.
_owner_rbac_id_note: An opaque local identifier for the single authorized owner, NOT your Telegram numeric ID and NOT a Paperclip UUID from another installation — generate a fresh one per install.
_cors_note: Only the local Hermes3D origin by default. Add others only if you understand the CSRF implications.
_rate_limit_note: Non-secret operational parameter from the reference architecture; adjust to your own load expectations.
